entities.name: Ustad Ali Maryam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Ustad Ali Maryam was an Iranian architect of the 19th century. He is known for designing three buildings in particular, all in Kashan:Borujerdi House (1857)
Tabatabai House (1840s)
Aminoddole Carvansarai (1863)
